releaseNotes: PDF Smart Search now adds Google Document AI Enterprise OCR for scanned/image PDFs while searchable PDFs remain local. Google OCR runs one PDF at a time and saves returned Arabic/English text into the local Smart Search Index for later local searches. Google OCR requires one-time Document AI project, processor and service-account setup inside Smart Search Index; credentials are encrypted on-device with Android Keystore. Images outside PDFs remain excluded in this version.
